lessons.goal: 利用對話及任務描述推測片語的非字面意思。

questions.evidence: [Event chat] Luca: Please arrive at three for a dry run of the welcome ceremony. Wen: Should I bring running shoes? Is it outdoors? Luca: Sorry, 'dry run' means a practice of the procedure. We will walk through the introductions and check the microphones in the hall.
questions.explanation: Luca 說在禮堂檢查麥克風與介紹程序。
questions.prompt: Where will the dry run occur?

questions.evidence: Wen: So guests are not attending yet? Luca: Right. We will use classmates as pretend guests. If a step is confusing, we can stop and adjust it. The real ceremony starts at five, after we have made any needed changes.
questions.explanation: 同學假扮來賓進行演練。
options: No one, because guests are forbidden.
questions.prompt: Who will act as guests during practice?

questions.evidence: Wen: So guests are not attending yet? Luca: Right. We will use classmates as pretend guests. If a step is confusing, we can stop and adjust it. The real ceremony starts at five, after we have made any needed changes.
questions.explanation: 演練時可停下來修改不清楚步驟。
options: To begin the real ceremony early.
questions.prompt: Why may the team stop during the practice?

questions.evidence: [Event chat] Luca: Please arrive at three for a dry run of the welcome ceremony. Wen: Should I bring running shoes? Is it outdoors? Luca: Sorry, 'dry run' means a practice of the procedure. We will walk through the introductions and check the microphones in the hall.
questions.explanation: Luca 在對話中直接解釋為流程排練。
options: A practice of a planned procedure.
A walk that must avoid every guest.

questions.evidence: Wen adds a plain-language explanation beneath the original reminder. Another new volunteer thanks her because he had been unsure too. Luca realizes that a phrase familiar to experienced organizers may be unclear to others. The practice is useful before anyone enters the hall: it reveals a communication problem while there is still time to fix it.
questions.explanation: 另一新志工也不懂，提問揭露共同疑惑。
options: Wen's question helped more than one person understand.
All volunteers had already attended the ceremony.
The original message needed no explanation.
questions.prompt: What does the other volunteer's thanks suggest?

Treat every practice as an athletic event.
Use more unfamiliar phrases to save time.
